title: Balancing Partition Forest for Causal Weighting
abstract: arXiv:2611.23524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Balancing weights are used in observational causal inference to construct a population in which the treatment is independent of observed pretreatment covariates. The ideal weight is the ratio between the product of the covariate and treatment marginals and their joint distribution, for binary and continuous treatments alike. We propose Balancing Partition Tree (BPT) and Balancing Partition Forest (BPF), which estimate this ratio on a learned rectangular partition of covariate--treatment space. Each split maximizes the gain in a Bregman divergence computed from joint and marginal counts. Two choices of divergence yield criteria that maximize the mutual information captured by the partition or reduce the squared error of the weights. We show that the population residual of either criterion bounds the bias of inverse-probability-weighted and doubly robust response estimators that use the population partition weights. translated_title: 用于因果加权的平衡划分森林
translated_abstract: 平衡权重在观察性因果推断中被用于构造一个使处理与观测到的预处理协变量相互独立的总体。理想权重是协变量与处理各自的边际分布乘积与其联合分布之间的比值，这一形式对二元处理和连续处理均适用。我们提出了平衡划分树（BPT）和平衡划分森林（BPF），它们在学习得到的协变量—处理空间的矩形划分上估计该比值。每一次分裂都最大化由联合计数与边际计数计算出的 Bregman 散度的增益。两种散度选择分别产生最大化划分所捕获互信息的准则，以及降低权重平方误差的准则。我们证明，任一准则的总体残差都为使用总体划分权重的逆概率加权（IPW）和双重稳健响应估计量的偏差提供了上界。在 17 个合成（数据集与真实数据集上的实验……原文摘要于此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出平衡划分树与平衡划分森林（BPT/BPF），通过在协变量—处理空间上以 Bregman 散度增益驱动分裂的矩形划分来估计理想平衡权重，并从理论上证明其总体残差可界定逆概率加权和双重稳健估计量的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Balancing Partition Tree and Balancing Partition Forest (BPT/BPF), which estimate ideal balancing weights via Bregman-divergence-maximizing rectangular partitions of the covariate-treatment space, and prove that the population residual of either criterion bounds the bias of inverse-probability-weighted and doubly robust estimators.
